translation: Li Binhu said: Although the Governing Vessel travels along the back, its branch collateral, going from Changqiang to the Ren vessel, runs straight up from the lower abdomen through the navel, passes through the heart in the middle, enters the throat, ascends to the chin, encircles the lips, and enters the inner canthus of the eye. Therefore these various signs appear; Qixuan had evidently not examined this deeply. The Plain Questions says: When the Governing Vessel is in excess, the spine becomes stiff and arches backward; when it is deficient, the head becomes heavy and sways high; for those with affliction along the bone, take [treatment] from its branch collateral.
